name: Ironband Wants You!
label: Quest
description: Ironband Wants You!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend. I received reports from Prospector Ironband at his excavation site in Loch Modan--he needs some legwork done concerning another of our excavations.
I don't have more details than that, but if you want to stretch your legs then go speak with Ironband.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So Stormpike sent you, did he? Good.
I have a big task for you...
